title: Practice 1: об-: around — из-: all over

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Новость ___ (облететь / облетать — to fly) весь дом.
exercises.why: The verb is followed by the preposition вокруг + Gen.: Самолёт облетел вокруг аэродрома. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Иван Гончаров, «Обрыв».
exercises.context: The verb is followed by the preposition вокруг + Gen.: Самолёт облетел вокруг аэродрома.

exercises.q: Я ___ (обойти / обходить — to go around, to bypass) парком.
exercises.why: **о-, об-, обо-** — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place — Девочка обошла лужу. — The little girl walked around the puddle. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Максим Горький, «Варенька Олесова».
exercises.context: о-, об-, обо- — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place — Девочка обошла лужу. — The little girl walked around the puddle.

exercises.q: Это горевшие свечи ___ (оплыть / оплывать — to swim around).
exercises.why: **оплы́ть** — **оплывать** — (transitive) to swim around; (intransitive) to swell up; to become bloated; to gutter (of a candle). **исходи́ть** — **исходи́ть** — (imperfective only) to issue (from), to come (from), to originate (from), to emanate (from); (imperfective only) to proceed (from), to base oneself (on)). **изъе́здить** — **изъе́здить** — to go, to travel all over; to ruin (e.g. a road) by riding on for too long. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Иван Бунин, «Кошка в крапиве за домом жила».
exercises.context: оплы́ть** — **оплывать — (transitive) to swim around; (intransitive) to swell up; to become bloated; to gutter (of a candle).

exercises.q: За что меня ___ (обходить / обойти — to go around, to bypass)?

Толстой, «Князь Серебряный».
exercises.context: обойти́** — **обходи́ть — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area).
